blocks.t: Midway's new table tennis game, WINNER, will be in your distributor's showroom soon, This game is being built under license and with the co-operation of Atari, Inc., of Santa Clara, California, (Syzygy Engineered), the inventor and developer of “the game.

Midway has reaped the benefits of months of location testing. WINNER lends itself to the sophisticated atmosphere of all locations. This unit has extra circuitry to allow the audience to view the match play on the location's television set, if desired.
The fascinating, competitive play has caught the eye of every age group, and has made it the most exciting game of the decade.

Coin switch #1 and #2 de-energizes the game over relay (M 33-1700).
Game over relay switch adjustment (Yellow- Green and White-Blue) or (Black-Green and Orange-Black).
Coin switch #1 and #2 energizes the coin relay.
Coin relay switch adjustment (Red and Green or Black).
Game logic unit jack connection pins #2, #4, #6, #7, #10, #12, #15, and #22.
Defective logic unit, (PC 567-904) or game timer unit (PC 567-907).
1.) Remove UHF and VHF internal-external antenna leads (tape) .
2.) Cut one side of R-124 resistor (100 ohm).
3.) Connect TP-4 terminal with Green lead wire to internal UHF antenna. (Left side #3).
4.) Connect E-3 terminal with Black lead wire to internal UHF antenna. (Right side #4).
5.) Connect Red wire to the White wire of volume control cable.
6.) Connect external volume control in series with T.v. speaker.
NOTE: Steps #1 through #4 eliminate T.V. picture.
13.) Remove all antenna leads and ground straps.
Cut Brown and Brown-Yellow wires from on and off switch (splice and tape).
Cut speaker leads and remove speaker (mounted externally).
Disconnect 9 and 2 pt. jacks and remove tuner assembly,
Cut green, yellow and ground wires at 9 pt. jack.
Plug in 9 pt. adapter cable jack.
Wire one end of added 3 wire cable to antenna terminals. Left side green then black and red (VHF & UHF).
Solder green of 3 wire cable to terminal TP-3 (logic).
Solder black of 3 wire cable to terminal link (ground).
Solder red of 3 wire cable to yellow removed from 9 pt. jack (audio).
Solder 47K ohm resistor across antenna terminals black and red.
Cut one end of resistor R-119 (1.2k).
Solder adapter cable black-yellow to 4 lug terminal strip with black.
Check T.V. set electrically in game.
Loss of 22V supply - suspect shorted Y402, open R404 or open R403. Loss of 130V supply - suspect R403. Loss of 140V supply - suspect R402,
1. Loss of vertical sweep - suspect Q205 first ar Q202 second,
2. Bad vertical linearity or insufficient sweep - suspect C204 first and Q203 second.
3. Uneven vertical sweep (poor linearity) check values or R223 or R226, Adjust rings on yoke.
he Foor vertical sync. - be sure I.F. AGC is full counter clock wise,
be Poor vertical linearity could be caused by bad yoke.
1. No horizontal sweep = suspect R263, R264, R265 or R266. Next suspect Q253. Always check Y¥253 when Q253 is defective. Suspect Y253 when there is no sweep.
2. If above checks are positive — suspect 251 then Q252.
3. Poor sync. - be sure I.F. AGC is full counter clockwise.
he Special horizontal circuit modification. To move picture 3/h inch to left, put .01 capicator in parallel with C253. Readjust horizontal oscillator frequency with C251.
Look for trouble in horizontal circuits,
No Video —- suspect Q104 first, Q105 second.
Poor contrast, be sure I.F. AGC is full counter clockwise.
No sound - suspect Q301. If \301 is defective, check R306 also.
No sound or distorted sound, replace a good audio module.
